programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Tha Bing air fhàgail cuide ri Sula 's Amma fhad 's a tha Flop sa bhùth a ceannachd biadh son lòn. Ge-tà, chan eil fad ann gus eil Bing ag ionndrainn Flop gu mòr! Bing finds himself being left with Sula and Amma when Flop goes to the shop to buy some food for lunch. However, it doesn't take Bing long to realise how much he misses Flop!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Tha Bing 's Pando air an aon bhogsa-lòin ùr fhaighinn, fear gleansach Hoppity Voosh! Ged 's e spòrs a th' ann an aon bhogsa bhith aca, tha beagan ùpraid ag èirigh nuair a thig am biadh aca am measg a chèile! Bing and Pando have the same lunchbox - a shiny new Hoppity Voosh one! Although it's fun to have the same box, the friends soon realise that it can cause great confusion when their lunches are mixed up!

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Tha na h-Abadas a' gabhail tòrr spòrs a' rolaigeadh sios cnoc. Ach tha geam sgoinneil eile aig Ben dhaibh: an geama fhaclan. Tha e a' toirt facal ùr iongantach dhaibh! Dè th'ann am 'boomerang' agus càit a bhiodh an t-àite as fheàrr airson fear a thilgeil? Thig is cluich le na h-Abadas fhad's a tha iad ga rannsachadh! We join the Abadas having an 'aba-doo-be-dee' time rolling down a hill. Ben has another great game for them to play: the word game. He introduces them to an exciting new word! What's a 'boomerang' and where would be the best place to throw one? Come and join the Abadas as they investigate!

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: Tha Àtaidh agus Tilidh a’ cur cafaidh air chois. Tha uallach orra nach tig duine dhan chafaidh aca, ach chan fheum uallach sam bith a bhith orra! Abney and Teal decide to set up a café. They're worried about not getting any customers, but they have no reason to be concerned.

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha Peicein a’ smaoineachadh dè cho àrd is a dh’fhàsadh craobhan mura deigheadh an leigeil? ‘S dòcha gun ruigeadh iad fànas! Tha e fhèin is a charaidean a’ cur plana air dòigh airson siubhal gu fànas, le bhith a’ sreap craobh. Ach chan fhada gus a bheil iad air turas eile gu ruige meadhan na talmhainn! Petit wonders how tall trees could grow if they never got cut down. Maybe they could grow into space! He and his friends plan a space journey on top of a tree, that will turn into a voyage to the centre of the Earth.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachd do chlann òga. Tha Ruairidh Gray a’ leughadh An Aisling Mhòr aig Beag. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh le Manjeet Mann, a dhealbhachadh le Amanda Quartey agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Morag Stiùbhart. Ruairidh Gray reads An Aisling Mhòr aig Beag by Manjeet Mann, illustrated by Amanda Quartey and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart.

programme.title: The Deep/An Doimhne
programme.desc: Nuair tha muc-mhara bhruideil, gheal ri sàbhaladh, tha Na Neachdan den bheachd gur h-e am Mòbaidh Dick a th’ innte. Feumar a dìon mus fhaigh Dànaidh Dalma faisg oirre ge-tà, oir tha e 'son a glacadh is a cur fo bhruid There’s a huge, white whale to be saved, and the Neachdan believe it could be Moby Dick. They must protect it before Dànaidh Dalma gets close though, as he wants to capture it.

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Tha Seonaidh a' miannachadh beatha nas inntinniche. Nuair a tha Shirley dha dhèanamh comasach gur dòcha gun tachair sin, tha e air a dhòigh. Ach am bi an Treud nan cnap-starra? Shaun dreams of a life in the fast lane. When Shirley lands upon something that could make his wish come true, he can't believe his luck. The only obstacle that stands in his way is the rest of the flock.

programme.title: An Saoghal Droil aig Pol Ploc/The Rubbish World of Dave Spud
programme.desc: Tha Pòl is a charaidean air an taghadh airson sgioba ball-coise na sgoile a bhrosnachadh, le bhith a’ gairm às leth na sgoile. Le cuideachadh bho Ghranaidh, tha iad gus an taisbeanadh as fheàrr a chur air dòigh airson sgoil a’ bhaile. Dave and his friends are enlisted as cheerleaders for their school sports team. With the help of Gran they are going to put on the best, and only, cheer performance their Grimsby school has ever seen.

programme.title: An Saoghal Droil aig Pol Ploc/The Rubbish World of Dave Spud
programme.desc: Tha Beileag a’ toirt clup uabhasach do Phòl ro dhiosgo bliadhnail na coimhearsnachd, is mar sin feumaidh e falt-fuadain a chur air. Gu mì-fhortanach, tha seo a’ toirt cruth-atharrachaidh air Pòl. Betty gives Dave a bad haircut ahead of the annual community disco, so Dave has to wear a wig. Unfortunately, his new stylish hairpiece comes with a few side effects.

programme.title: Dùbhlain DIY (Instructions Not Included)
programme.desc: Derek Murray hosts a fun knockout amateur DIY competition where couples go head to head. Derek Moireach le farpais spòrsail DIY is cupail a’ strì an aghaidh a chèile.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: The guest is Fanch Bihan-Gallic who hails from Brittany, and Calum Maclean gets his hands on the local currency in the Findhorn Community in Morayshire.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Dealbhan Fraoich/Heather's Portraits
programme.desc: Combining the role of artist and interviewer, Heather Dewar creates colour portraits of well-known Gaels, while teasing out of them every little detail of their life story! Heather meets Ciorstag Wilson, who recently moved back to her native Mull after spending years on the mainland. Not only is Ciorstag a teacher in Tobermory, but she is one of Gaeldom’s most celebrated social media influencers, posting video tutorials and tips on make-up and beauty. Tha Fraoch Nic an Deòir a Ìle air ais air an sgrion le sreath ùr de “Dhealbhan Fraoich”. An dà chuid na tè-ealain agus na ceasnaiche, tha i a’dèanamh dealbhan dathte de Ghàidheil air a bheil sinn eòlach – agus a’tàladh asta iomadh sgeul mu eachdraidh am beatha. Sa chiad phrògram dhen t-sreath tha Fraoch a’coinneachadh ri Ciorstag NicUilleim, a thill dhachaigh a Mhuile o chionn ghoirid, as dèidh bliadhnaichean air tìr-mòr. Chan e mhàin gu bheil Ciorstag a’teagasg – ach tha i ainmeil air Ghaidhealtachd mar thè le buaidh air na meadhanan shòisealta, a’cur leasain bhideo air-loidhne, is molaidhean mu mhaise gnùis agus bòidhchead. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Luchd-Brathaidh Cogaidh | Spies of War
programme.desc: 1962: Tha an saoghal air fad air bhioran agus cogadh niùclasach air fàire ri linn astasan Sobhietach ann an Cùba. Air cùl ghnothaichean, tha neach-brathaidh Sobhietach a’ cuideachadh Kennedy an aghaidh Khruschev. Ionnsaich mar a bhrath Oleg Penkovsky an t-Aonadh Sobhietach – agus mar a chaidh an Treas Cogadh Saoghail a sheachnadh. 1962: The world holds its breath as nuclear war looms during the Cuban Missile Crisis. Behind the scenes, a Soviet spy helps Kennedy face Khrushchev. Discover how Oleg Penkovsky betrayed the USSR - and helped avert World War III. Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Binneas - Na Trads
programme.desc: Seata cuirme le Rory Matheson Dance Band le Graham’s Jigs agus Irish Reels. Clàraichte beò aig Duaisean nan Trads 2025 ann an Obar Dheathain. Concert set performed by Rory Matheson Dance Band, featuring the tracks Graham’s Jigs and Irish Reels. Originally recorded live at the 2025 Trad Awards in Aberdeen.

programme.title: Glan Fhèin
programme.desc: Angela and Katie compete against Shonnie and Calum from rival company Sgiobalta. It’s an upstairs-downstairs, girls v boys clean-off where the winner gets the contract. Things get messy, featuring stains, smudges and romantic complications. The timing isn’t perfect, as it clashes with the anniversary of Katie’s infamous disastrous reality TV appearance. Meanwhile, Betty and Dido are on a publicity push where they ditch leaflets and embrace dancing on social media. And Daniel makes a new furry friend as he gets busy with his air freshener.

programme.title: An Sgoth
programme.desc: Se obair la toiseachadh agus b'e obair bliadhna a bh'ann an sgoth Niseach a chriochnachadh. Tha am program seo a' leanntainn an obair togail , na daoine a bha sas ann ag urachadh seann sgillean agus nab ha a-mach is a-steach a'ceilidh oirre. In 1994 work began in Lewis to construct a special boat using traditional skills. The Sgoth was the traditional fishing boat of the Ness district of Lewis and this film follows the year-long project to construct a sea-worthy vessel.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: Tha am preasantair Coinneach MacFhraing agus an Stiùiriche Hamish MacLeòid ag innse a h-uile càil mun t-sreath de phrògraman ‘Dàna’. Tha am prògram sònraichte seo a’ coimhead air cùlaibh ghnothaichean air an turas dànachd Eòrpach aig Coinneach gu Nirribhidh agus dhan Spàinn. Presenter Coinneach MacFhraing and director Hamish MacLeod spill the tea on all things Dàna. This special episode peeks behind the scenes of Coinneach’s bold European adventures to Norway and Spain. In Gaelic with English subtitles

They compete to draw together the connections between things which, at first glance, seem utterly random.

programme.title: AI Decoded
programme.desc: Not long ago, artificial intelligence was being sold as a science-fiction reality, a force that could transform society, cure disease, and remake the economy. Now, the mood is shifting. The companies driving the boom are racing for investment while grappling with a tougher reality: AI is costly, unpredictable, and not yet profitable. Even some of its creators warn progress may be too fast, as public anxiety grows and political resistance takes shape. Is AI now at a tipping point - caught between financial pressure, technological risk and a rising backlash?

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Uzbekistan were one of the first teams to secure their World Cup finals place a year ago, and they meet Colombia in their opening game in Group K in Mexico City. It’s a first ever World Cup appearance for Uzbekistan, who are managed by Italian former World Cup winner Fabio Cannavaro. Colombia were Copa America runners-up in 2024 and beat both Argentina and Brazil in qualifying for this tournament. The class and flair of Bayern Munich winger Luis Diaz means they could be a team to watch this summer.

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives
programme.desc: Matt Allwright meets the doorbell detectives whose pet camera helped snare a cat burglar. Shocking video doorbell footage shows a masked gang on the rampage in the early hours of the morning. The theft of a doorbell camera is the downfall for one criminal as he returns to the scene of a crime only to discover the stolen doorbell has alerted the homeowner. And former police inspector Anton Sullivan is the cop turned robber as he burgles a home to help the rest of us stay one step ahead of the thieves.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as Czech Republic play their second game in Group A against South Africa at Atlanta Stadium. Since losing in the final for a second time in 1962 as Czechoslovakia, they have only once made it past the initial group stage – reaching the quarter-finals in 1990. This is their first World Cup in 20 years. They could rely on the experience of West Ham’s Tomas Soucek in midfield. Despite not getting out of the group stage in any of their three previous World Cups, the Bafana Bafana have only lost three of their nine matches, and famously beat holders France in 2010.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as Czech Republic play their second game in Group A against South Africa at Atlanta Stadium. Since losing in the final for a second time in 1962 as Czechoslovakia, they have only once made it past the initial group stage – reaching the quarter-finals in 1990. This is their first World Cup in 20 years. They could rely on the experience of West Ham’s Tomas Soucek in midfield. Despite not getting out of the group stage in any of their three previous World Cups, the Bafana Bafana have only lost three of their nine matches, and famously beat holders France in 2010.

programme.title: Election 26
programme.desc: Laura Kuenssberg is your guide as three parliamentary constituencies choose a new MP. The BBC's political editor, Chris Mason, is at the count in Makerfield, where the mayor of Greater Manchester, Andy Burnham, is seeking a return to Westminster. Scotland correspondents are live in Aberdeen and Arbroath, as the SNP tries to hold two marginal seats that it won at the 2024 General Election. Political correspondent Alex Forsyth is in the studio, keeping her sharp eye across the latest political reaction. Professor Sir John Curtice analyses the key electoral trends. And a panel of senior politicians give their reactions to the verdicts.

programme.title: Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: The interceptors take on scammers posing as the police, who even use fake recordings of walkie-talkie chatter to frighten their targets into believing they are genuinely speaking to the authorities. programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Denise Nurse is in Suffolk, helping a couple find a new home in a more rural setting, where they can enjoy retired life together, closer to the coast, lakes or waterways. programme.title: Garden Rescue

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as Czech Republic play their second game in Group A against South Africa at Atlanta Stadium. Since losing in the final for a second time in 1962 as Czechoslovakia, they have only once made it past the initial group stage – reaching the quarter-finals in 1990. This is their first World Cup in 20 years. They could rely on the experience of West Ham’s Tomas Soucek in midfield. Despite not getting out of the group stage in any of their three previous World Cups, the Bafana Bafana have only lost three of their nine matches, and famously beat holders France in 2010.

programme.title: Election 26
programme.desc: Laura Kuenssberg is your guide as three parliamentary constituencies choose a new MP. The BBC's political editor, Chris Mason, is at the count in Makerfield, where the mayor of Greater Manchester, Andy Burnham, is seeking a return to Westminster. Scotland correspondents are live in Aberdeen and Arbroath, as the SNP tries to hold two marginal seats that it won at the 2024 General Election. And a panel of senior politicians give their reactions to the verdicts.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Uzbekistan were one of the first teams to secure their World Cup finals place a year ago, and they meet Colombia in their opening game in Group K in Mexico City. Colombia were Copa America runners-up in 2024 and beat both Argentina and Brazil in qualifying for this tournament. programme.title: Election 26
programme.desc: Laura Kuenssberg is your guide as three parliamentary constituencies choose a new MP. The BBC's political editor, Chris Mason, is at the count in Makerfield, where the mayor of Greater Manchester, Andy Burnham, is seeking a return to Westminster. Scotland correspondents are live in Aberdeen and Arbroath, as the SNP tries to hold two marginal seats that it won at the 2024 General Election. Political correspondent Alex Forsyth is in the studio, keeping her sharp eye across the latest political reaction. Professor Sir John Curtice analyses the key electoral trends. And a panel of senior politicians give their reactions to the verdicts.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as Czech Republic play their second game in Group A against South Africa at Atlanta Stadium. Since losing in the final for a second time in 1962 as Czechoslovakia, they have only once made it past the initial group stage – reaching the quarter-finals in 1990. This is their first World Cup in 20 years. They could rely on the experience of West Ham’s Tomas Soucek in midfield. Despite not getting out of the group stage in any of their three previous World Cups, the Bafana Bafana have only lost three of their nine matches, and famously beat holders France in 2010.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as Czech Republic play their second game in Group A against South Africa at Atlanta Stadium. Since losing in the final for a second time in 1962 as Czechoslovakia, they have only once made it past the initial group stage – reaching the quarter-finals in 1990. programme.title: Reporting Scotland
programme.desc: More from the day’s top stories and communities across Scotland.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: You could say that Lynn Cameron’s garden is a load of rubbish. Lynn has transformed the shared waste pile behind her house into a sustainable garden made entirely from recycled items and seeds from seed share programmes. Lynn has created a folly built entirely from discarded stones and bricks, a pond from old tyres, and a large seat from old decking boards. She even rescued an old stained-glass window to incorporate into her folly. Most of her garden has been sourced at little to no cost, yet she has managed to develop a haven full of exotic plants and eye-catching garden features.

programme.title: Grand Tours of Scotland's Rivers
programme.desc: Paul explores the lower reaches of the river Spey - Scotland’s third longest river, famous for its forests, whisky distilleries and salmon - as it flows north towards the coast. On the way Paul hears tales of loggers who floated timber down the river from the 17th century onwards. He then takes to the water in a canoe and discovers the rare and endangered freshwater mussels that were once harvested for their precious pearls, which adorn royal crowns. Sampling a dram of the original water of life, Paul reaches the mouth of the Spey where shipyards launched vessels to sail the seven seas. Finally, Paul meets the last salmon net fisherman on the river and learns how nets were used to catch the fish, which were then packed in ice and sent by rail to London.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: Beechgrove Garden is full of information for gardeners across the country who have to cope with the colder climates of the UK. Beechgrove has had some cold nights even recently, but now it looks like it’s safe to plant out those tender varieties, so Lizzie Schofield and Brian Cunningham are finally putting in the ground varieties that wouldn't survive a frost. In a warmer environment, Lizzie is checking on her tomatoes, and this year she is comparing hybrid and heritage varieties, with both needing some attention right now to maximise their productivity. Brian is in the Accessible Garden looking at recent changes that will make the plot easier to move around and work in for anyone with mobility problems. There is also a trip to Leven to catch up with Calum in his allotment, and there are all the usual handy hints.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: With the berry harvest in full swing, Dougie is in the East Neuk of Fife, where he discovers how the strawberry season has extended over the last 20 years. Cammy is in North Lanarkshire meeting the sheep dresser who gets livestock competition-ready for the Royal Highland Show. With the price of wool on the rise, Rosie visits the grading depot in Selkirk to find out what is driving the increasing value of fleeces. Shahbaz is in Moray stepping into the high-tech tree nursery that is the biggest in the UK, growing 19 million saplings a year. And Leanna is in Aberdeen to meet the scent-detection dogs fighting for native red squirrels by sniffing out invasive greys.

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: On Lewis, officers are fighting the drug trade. Acting on intel, they raid a suburban home which they suspect is connected to dealing. In Inverness, a man with a knife has barricaded himself in his home, and police need to respond before it gets out of control. In Ardnamurchan, police intervene as tensions mount between a protester and a fish farm.

programme.title: Scot Squad
programme.desc: Scotland's favourite comic cops are back on the beat for a brand new series, chasing down fresh leads and upholding ancient laws. Traffic officers Surjit Singh and Hugh McKirdy get a rude awakening when they pull over an unlikely lothario's defaced van. Urban duo Jack McLaren and Sarah Fletcher make a revealing discovery when they respond to a pair of convivial naturists. Covert cop Archie Pepper pounces on criminals who share too much on social media. Volunteer officer Ken Beattie answers a distress call and undertakes a full programme of cleaning, washing and ironing. Chief Cameron Miekelson keeps his nose to the grindstone and his ear to the bagpipes as he personally selects a contemporary playlist. Spoof comedy shadowing a fictional Scottish police force, starring Jack Docherty, Manjot Sumal, Grado, Jordan Young, Sally Reid, James Allenby-Kirk. With special guest Paul James Corrigan, and introducing Stuart McPherson.

programme.title: Janey and Ashley Get a Real Job
programme.desc: Comedians Janey Godley and her daughter Ashley Storrie try working on a farm to prove they have what it takes to cut it outside the world of comedy.

programme.title: Scotcast
programme.desc: Conversation about Scotland’s biggest news stories, hosted by Martin Geissler.

programme.title: Life on the Bay
programme.desc: The caravan park owned and run by three generations of the Wallace family plays a big part in the community on the Fife coast. Manager Steven has volunteered at the nearby RNLI station since he was 17 and is on call. A park resident has recently joined a another kind of community - the bay’s wild swimmers - and goes for a dip with friends. Meanwhile, head chef James welcomes a new recruit to the kitchen, and the sun shines on a fund-raising fete.

programme.title: Peelers: The PSNI for Real
programme.desc: Acting on a tip off, the Peelers storm a city centre flat on a drugs bust. Inside, a startled suspect is immediately cuffed and arrested while outside, the PSNI team search the nearby streets for the suspected big-time dealer they think may have fled the scene with more drugs. On Great Victoria Street in Belfast city centre, police attempt to arrest a man who refuses to comply with a search. The situation quickly escalates, and he is detained by a number of officers who use a spit guard and leg restraints. The man is taken into custody, where he continues to kick off. Officers and custody staff surround the man in his cell as they try to get him under control. Later, Stephen interviews the deputy chief constable, Bobby Singleton, and questions him about some PSNI tactics and officers’ use of force.

programme.title: Two Weeks in August
programme.desc: Accusations fly when the housekeeper reveals she saw Jon desecrating her local chapel with ‘one of them’ last night. On a group outing to an ancient temple, Zoe, Solomon and Jacob are caught in a terrible car accident that threatens to ruin not just the holiday but also their lives. As Solomon admits his failings to Zoe, Jacob starts to suspect she is the one to blame for all this. Nat desperately tries to undo a drunken mistake, leaving Jess and Dan alone together for the first time since the kiss.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Steve Brown heads to Suffolk with a couple from an East Sussex town who are utterly devoted to their three whippets and are desperate to leave their 1960s bungalow. They dream of running a small glamping escape, complete with a shepherd’s hut for guests and a garden for their speedy, four-legged companions. Property picks include a striking mystery house and even homes with more than one staircase! Steve also takes to his bicycle to test out a newly created cycling route that winds through some of Suffolk’s most glorious countryside.

programme.title: The Travelling Auctioneers
programme.desc: Bee and JJ go rummaging in Woking, helping a grieving widow sort through years of zoo memorabilia. Can gold sovereigns and a stone eagle fund a bedroom for Jan’s great-niece?

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As summer hits its stride at Longmeadow, Monty Don brings a burst of colour to the Jewel Garden with vibrant annuals, plants out tender veg, and shares some practical advice for tackling greenhouse pests. Arit Anderson visits a striking garden in Greater Manchester packed with clever design solutions and wildlife-friendly planting that comes alive by day and night. In Dorset, Joe Swift explores a much-loved family garden reimagined for three generations. In Essex, a gardener has transformed a shaded, north-facing plot into a lush, lawn-free haven, while in Bristol, a Morris dancer channels movement and rhythm into her planting as she prepares for Gardeners’ World Live in Birmingham.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The big political issues of the day.

programme.title: Queen's Tennis
programme.desc: Live coverage from day 11 of the 2026 Queen's tennis tournament.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Ben Bailey Smith, Robin Ince, Lara Ricote and Helen Skelton take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted with the very popular bee hotel?

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo’s Scandinavian rail adventure reaches Denmark’s second city, Aarhus, an architectural playground with dazzling contemporary buildings set alongside historic half-timbered houses. At the striking mid-century city hall, he learns about its design and one of its architects, Arne Jacobsen. At Jelling, Michael reads the runes to discover the birthplace of Denmark. Once a royal Viking burial site, Jelling has two 10th-century runic stones. Michael connects with King Harald Bluetooth to learn how Norse paganism gave way to Christianity. Michael crosses the Old Little Belt Bridge from Jutland to Middelfart on the island of Funen, once a whaling centre and now home to a large population of the smallest whales, porpoises. At Odense, he is transported back to the time of Danish author Hans Christian Andersen at a living history village, where he struggles to walk in clogs and learns to make bread.

programme.title: The One Show
programme.desc: Alex Jones and Roman Kemp bring you the stories that matter from across the country.

programme.title: Cricket: Today at the Test
programme.desc: Day 2 highlights from the second Test match between England and New Zealand.

programme.title: Villages by the Sea
programme.desc: In Hampshire, archaeologist Ben Robinson investigates how a tiny village, originally meant to be a free port to process sugar, became a bustling naval shipyard. Ben learns that three ships built here would lead Nelson to victory at Trafalgar. Then, in an almost untouched 18th-century labourer’s cottage, Ben gets a feel for just how basic life was for hardworking rural families 250 years ago.

programme.title: Queen James: Passion, Plots and Power in the Court of Britain’s First King
programme.desc: Gareth Russell reveals the story of King James VI and I, his fondness for male favourites and a scandalous murder trial that threatened to blow his monarchy apart.

programme.title: BBC Wales Investigates
programme.desc: You could be a scroll away from finding a sperm donor. But at what cost? With fertility prices soaring and treatment difficult to access for some, same-sex female couples say they have little choice but to turn to social media to make a baby. Social media groups and apps are fuelling a cheap, easy and totally unregulated donor market. But it’s risky: outside of a sperm clinic, there’s no guarantee of health screening, and you’re not legally protected. And it’s not just a gamble for those wanting to get pregnant. Officers and custody staff surround the man in his cell as they try to get him under control. Later, Stephen interviews the deputy chief constable, Bobby Singleton, and questions him about some PSNI tactics and officers’ use of force.

programme.title: Two Weeks in August
programme.desc: Accusations fly when the housekeeper reveals she saw Jon desecrating her local chapel with ‘one of them’ last night. On a group outing to an ancient temple, Zoe, Solomon and Jacob are caught in a terrible car accident that threatens to ruin not just the holiday but also their lives. As Solomon admits his failings to Zoe, Jacob starts to suspect she is the one to blame for all this. Nat desperately tries to undo a drunken mistake, leaving Jess and Dan alone together for the first time since the kiss.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Steve Brown heads to Suffolk with a couple from an East Sussex town who are utterly devoted to their three whippets and are desperate to leave their 1960s bungalow. They dream of running a small glamping escape, complete with a shepherd’s hut for guests and a garden for their speedy, four-legged companions. Property picks include a striking mystery house and even homes with more than one staircase! Steve also takes to his bicycle to test out a newly created cycling route that winds through some of Suffolk’s most glorious countryside.

programme.title: The Travelling Auctioneers
programme.desc: Bee and JJ go rummaging in Woking, helping a grieving widow sort through years of zoo memorabilia. Can gold sovereigns and a stone eagle fund a bedroom for Jan’s great-niece?

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As summer hits its stride at Longmeadow, Monty Don brings a burst of colour to the Jewel Garden with vibrant annuals, plants out tender veg, and shares some practical advice for tackling greenhouse pests. Arit Anderson visits a striking garden in Greater Manchester packed with clever design solutions and wildlife-friendly planting that comes alive by day and night. In Dorset, Joe Swift explores a much-loved family garden reimagined for three generations. In Essex, a gardener has transformed a shaded, north-facing plot into a lush, lawn-free haven, while in Bristol, a Morris dancer channels movement and rhythm into her planting as she prepares for Gardeners’ World Live in Birmingham.

programme.title: Politics Live

programme.title: Queen's Tennis
programme.desc: Live coverage from day 11 of the 2026 Queen's tennis tournament.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Ben Bailey Smith, Robin Ince, Lara Ricote and Helen Skelton take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted with the very popular bee hotel?

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo’s Scandinavian rail adventure reaches Denmark’s second city, Aarhus, an architectural playground with dazzling contemporary buildings set alongside historic half-timbered houses. At the striking mid-century city hall, he learns about its design and one of its architects, Arne Jacobsen. At Jelling, Michael reads the runes to discover the birthplace of Denmark. Once a royal Viking burial site, Jelling has two 10th-century runic stones. Michael connects with King Harald Bluetooth to learn how Norse paganism gave way to Christianity. Michael crosses the Old Little Belt Bridge from Jutland to Middelfart on the island of Funen, once a whaling centre and now home to a large population of the smallest whales, porpoises. At Odense, he is transported back to the time of Danish author Hans Christian Andersen at a living history village, where he struggles to walk in clogs and learns to make bread.

programme.title: The One Show

programme.title: Cricket: Today at the Test
programme.desc: Day 2 highlights from the second Test match between England and New Zealand.

programme.title: Villages by the Sea
programme.desc: In Hampshire, archaeologist Ben Robinson investigates how a tiny village, originally meant to be a free port to process sugar, became a bustling naval shipyard. Ben learns that three ships built here would lead Nelson to victory at Trafalgar. Then, in an almost untouched 18th-century labourer’s cottage, Ben gets a feel for just how basic life was for hardworking rural families 250 years ago.

programme.title: Reported Missing
programme.desc: Police launch high-risk searches for two missing women - 22-year-old Santra was last seen on CCTV 10 days ago, while 52-year-old Laura vanished without trace two weeks ago.

programme.title: BBC Wales Investigates
programme.desc: You could be a scroll away from finding a sperm donor. But at what cost? With fertility prices soaring and treatment difficult to access for some, same-sex female couples say they have little choice but to turn to social media to make a baby. Social media groups and apps are fuelling a cheap, easy and totally unregulated donor market. But it’s risky: outside of a sperm clinic, there’s no guarantee of health screening, and you’re not legally protected. And it’s not just a gamble for those wanting to get pregnant. According to the UK’s fertility regulator, men who donate sperm outside of clinics may also be breaking the law if they’re storing, processing or sending sperm. But what do they think of this? Meet the men travelling the world to donate sperm, and find out what happens when reporter Gemma Dunstan tries to order a sample online.

programme.title: Gods of Tennis
programme.desc: It’s 1975, and two tennis greats – Billie Jean King and Arthur Ashe – are aiming to win Wimbledon titles but also, in their own ways, to change the world for the better. Back in the late 60s, as the women’s liberation movement becomes headline news, Billie Jean King takes up the gauntlet for women in sport. Having dominated the women's game for years, winning several Wimbledon Championships, King is spearheading the drive for equal prize money and equal treatment of women, whilst Ashe focuses his attention on racial equality on and off the court.

programme.title: Playtime Towers

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and Sula really enjoy painting a giant mural at Amma's nursery, until Bing's enthusiastic rainbow painting makes paint run all over Sula's beautiful tree. Sula is upset, until Flop and Amma help them see that the painting isn't spoiled - it's just different. In fact, the harder they look the more they can see that they have painted a beautiful rainbow tree.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘rain’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. This episode is all about rain – drops of rain, trickly rain, pitter-patter rain, rainbow rain and really big splasher rain! We see Dee and a friend catching rain, and spot Dee singing in the rain. The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Lu upsets Grace when she doesn't follow her instructions.

programme.desc: Kiri and Lou are upset with each other but can’t remember why.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: The Froglets explore Lilly's desk then set sail on a daring pirate quest for treasure.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: Stop-motion preschool programme about the adventures of four inquisitive Twirlywoos. The Twirlywoos are at a campsite where they watch a hiker attaching things to his rucksack. While he peruses a map, the Twirlywoos decide to join more things onto the bag - including the chair the hiker is sitting in, and the tent itself. When the hiker gets up and begins to walk off, the entire campsite follows after him! The Twirlywoos return to the boat to find the Twirlywoo Screen. A series of dots appears, and when the Twirlywoos touch them, they join up into a picture of a bus. Little stick-figure passengers appear in each of the windows, and wave to the Twirlywoos, before the bus starts up and drives right off the wall!

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin is in for a surprise today when he meets two Irish dancing stars who set him a challenge. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble is trying to earn a star for his star chart by washing Lord Tumble's car.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Dipsy and Laa-Laa drive to the Hidey Hup in the Tubby Car. They meet Tinky Winky and Po and the Teletubbies go on the Tubby Uppy Downy together.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Nigel and Baby Bear welcome little ones Minnie, Luna, Oliver, River, Theo and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their babies at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! Inside Nigel’s bag are a toy pig, a toy sheep and a toy chicken, and all the parents and babies have different objects and toys that are themed around things you might find at a farm. These are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding safe, baby-appropriate farm objects and toys inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun song Old MacDonald Had A Farm features, as does a story involving Baby Bear, and viewers at home show how they’ve been exploring farm things too. The Together Song gets everyone moving about before some calm time with sensory scarves and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children create binoculars using recycled tubes and decorations, learn British Sign Language signs for sailor, sea and see, then sing and sign A Sailor Went to Sea, Sea, Sea.

programme.title: What’s in Your Plant Pot?
programme.desc: Allotment gardener Chloe Taylor and the Fact Pack discover how the wind helps sweetcorn plants grow, and just how many little kernels are on one cob. We also learn how yummy popcorn pops!

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: The animals are napping but Alcatraz the tortoise wants to play. Ranger Hamza spots some wonderful waterbuck in the wild and learns how to prepare a cosy bed for the elephants.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger is leading the baby Pea-Rexes home through a shortcut and gets lost.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey needs her mum's advice on dealing with a troublesome neighbour when the serenity of her couch cushion playhouse is threatened by Bingo's own growing stable of animals.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The day starts when Duggee moves a cupboard, and the Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind it. It’s Duggee’s diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels aren’t sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: The Colourblocks discover that it can be fun to colour things wrong. Learn about choosing colours with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Ezra discovers lots of interesting facts about crabs! Rory and his son Sandy take a trip to the seaside to look in rock pools for crabs. Ferne meets a crab with no shell of its own at the aquarium. Also, we find out how important crabs are to the environment as they act as little litter pickers of the seabed.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Sisters Kyra and Khloe go on a big family day out to a farm. There are lots of exciting things to do, including a pony ride, or should that be a unicorn ride? They explore an amazing maze where the girls find a giant sunflower! But will they ever find their way back out? They also discover a very muddy and squelchy pumpkin patch and pick their perfect pumpkins! This Bafta-winning pre-school observational documentary follows the lives of young children and their families from a variety of backgrounds across the UK.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: On the menu is delicious tandoori chicken cooked in a traditional clay oven called a tandoor. Ria and Rohan use their grandma's special oven to make their version of this classic Indian dish. They cook chicken coated in a yoghurt sauce, which is spiced and full of flavour. They serve it to their friends alongside naan bread and yoghurt mint sauce. Plus learn about India, the land of spices, and find out some interesting facts about garlic, which is the special ingredient in this recipe. Will Ria and Rohan's friends like the taste of garlic in their chicken, and how will they feel about eating with their hands?

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: In this episode, Maddie is relaxing at home. She finds out what happens to our bodies when we go to sleep at night. Using a special sleep monitor, Maddie shows us that our bodies do not simply switch off but are in fact doing lots of important things while we sleep. She discovers how our breathing and heart rate slow down and how sometimes our eyes flicker. Next she visits a factory where sofas are made. Maddie follows the journey the wood takes: from cutting the planks, to building the frame, to making the upholstery to cover it. Maddie puts her special slow-motion camera inside a cushion to show us how a special machine blasts the feathers into the cushions at incredible speeds.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Tinks is a disability assistance dog for her owner Charli, who has a condition that makes it painful for her to pick things up or to push and pull things. Tinks uses her superfetch skills to help Charli every day. The smallest of the Dog Squad gang, Tinks is a little Lhasa Apso with lots of big dog energy. Charli has been invited to a party but is feeling a bit nervous about going. Tinks loves helping Charli feel confident. She wants to help Charli feel good about herself so she can go and have fun at the party. Tinks fetches Charli’s hairbrush so Charli can brush her newly dyed pink hair, and then helps Charli choose a party outfit. And, when Charli can’t find her keys, Tinks dives into a mountain of clothes on the bed to search for them. Now they’re party ready, but it's raining! Tinks is determined to help Charli get to the party, even in the rain. But how? She summons all her big dog energy and sets off in search of a plan. Just wait until Dog Squad hear about this!

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet some elands, the largest type of antelope, which spend most of their days grazing on grass. The pair discover that these huge animals can leap high into the air. Next, Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet some colobus monkeys, which jump and leap all around them. They have an incredible close encounter with these marvellous monkeys. These two animals are very different, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between them.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Oona and Baba search for soft bedding for their burrow.

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: Animated series about a group of singing potatoes. Ruby and her friends head off to the barbershop to get their hair styled in this Motown music video.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: The garden gang are intrigued when Yukee says she’s going to stay up late with them so that she can show them the Man in the Moon. But will they all be able to stay awake long enough to see him?

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs are camping in the woods with Dad. But when rain comes to spoil their campfire fun, they all rush inside the tent. Dad is not happy, but a visit from a cheerful little raindrop soon has the whole gang dancing around the tent.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Are you sitting comfortably? Then we'll begin a bedtime story all about the first five Numberblocks. Learn all about the numbers one, two, three, four and five with Numberblocks One to Five.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: O is fascinated as G grows her green hair into a grassy garden. P and friends pop in to make a popping pea pod in a pot, but when a digging dog shows up, it is time for trouble. This episode introduces the letters G and O and the words pot, pod, dog and dig.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin meets Jamie at the playing field to try out some different games, and George joins them for a game of boccia. Mr Tumble is feeling sporty too as he gets ready to go swimming. The spotty surprise is a sports day race. Featuring signs for the words running track, swimming and medal.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Preschool series. Laa-Laa and Po play a game of hide-and-seek. They both take turns at hiding. Tinky Winky and Dipsy are hiding too and Laa-Laa and Po find them together.

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back 220 million years to the time of Coelophysis - one of the earliest dinosaurs that hunted in packs and was an expert at fishing. His mission is to find a fish to replace the one that was eaten by Taffy the cat back at the museum. Along the way he witnesses pterosaurs fishing, as well as discovering that the fish he's after buries itself in the ground when the river dries up. But will Andy succeed in time before the museum opens?

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s Stall. She chooses the plastic hook-a-duck and remembers the day she got it. Mack has organised a game day with lots of old-fashioned games at the Big Hub and is desperate for it to be a success. At first, everyone joins in the fun and things go well. Alice sets up Snakes and Ladders in the Cafe, and Magnus is very keen to play his family’s favourite game, Chinbeard. Unfortunately, as the day goes on, things start to go awry. Mrs Juniper and Moira become a little too competitive over Snakes and Ladders, and Magnus can’t find anyone who knows how to play his favourite game. Can any of the Hubbers help Mack before game day turns into a complete disaster?

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: CBeebies’ very own motorcycle rider, Grace, shows off three amazing machines that all go on water. Grace first lifts off the water using a hydrofoil surfboard, then she shows off an amazing yacht transporter and does her best superhero impression on a hydroflier!

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Iona and Elba pretend to be astronauts and head off on a space mission. Things get really exciting when they bump into two friendly aliens!

programme.desc: When his little brother Pinto gets trapped on a piece of ice, Peso has to rescue him.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: After learning that Duggee is making his yearly batch of blueberry jam, a tradition passed on from his great-aunt, the Squirrels decide to spread the news. They learn that you can be told about, read about, hear about or watch news, so each Squirrel takes on their own important role in reporting on this exciting topic, whether that be in the kitchen, in the studio or walking through the blueberry fields.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Grandpa Beaver has a leak in his dam, and it’s up to the Sweetwood Explorers to help him!

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: It’s the Tin Can Games, and Evil Pea wants to win the Tin Can trophy. She cheats in the final race by putting a magnet on Supertato’s back to stop him from going super fast.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy and the Ducklings discover a treasure map. Weasy steals it and sets off alone on the trail, but the Ducklings are determined not to miss out and want the map back!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mojo’s got the perfect top for digging up the bones of a Swoppitus Rex. But could an actual dinosaur still be alive under Jackson’s field, or is it a case of mistaken identity?

programme.desc: The Fantastics playfully sack Georgie. Jaz is appointed as the team’s new coach but finds it harder than she thought. Georgie tries her hand at other jobs - with chaotic results.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.desc: Rafi is busy making a half birthday card for baby Oscar, but with ukulele practice, library reading and Teacup the dog to play with, she has a lot to do. She wishes for more versions of herself, and four colourful Rafis appear. Chaos ensues, until Dash encourages Rafi to take charge. She gets each Rafi to focus on one job - crafts, reading, music and play. At the café, the Rafis sing for Oscar, present the card, and then merge back into one.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo is determined to slide down the big slide at the park. But even though it’s sunny when they leave the house, a rainy weather forecast threatens her plans. Luckily for her, Gran Gran has come prepared!

programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Scarf Lady has run out of wool, so Sarah and Duck help her to harvest the weeping woollen tree.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Tiny and Small plant a little plant in mother's garden, but they get impatient for it to grow. They sing a growing song as the cloud fills their watering can but do not anticipate the effect this mixture of water and music will have on their plant! Only the intervention of the plant-eating Sky Moos saves their planet from being overrun by vegetation!

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa think they’ve found a butterfly but are surprised to learn that it’s a moth - it sleeps during the day and comes out to play at night. At Play Time, they shine a toy torch into dark places and accidentally disturb the moth. It follows them to Yummy Land, where the Yummies help the friends learn more about nocturnal life, gifting them a moon flower that only opens at night.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read bedtime stories. Makka Pakka sets off through the garden looking for stones, but he loses his way. He gets concerned that he will not be able to find his way back. He is relieved when the Pinky Ponk appears. Makka Pakka follows the Pinky Ponk all the way home.

programme.desc: Sula and Amma have come to Bing's house for lunch but there are no carrots, so Flop pops to the shop to get some. Bing stays behind but it's not long before he starts to miss Flop. Missing Flop... it's a Bing thing!

programme.desc: Tinky Winky's bag fills up with sparkles from a tap, and when Home Dome overflows with tubby custard, Po has to turn the Tubby Custard Machine off. A child in Tummy Tales uses a new tap in the bathroom when she brushes her teeth before bedtime.

But she turns the boots up to the highest setting, which sends them haywire and cause her to score own goals - and even kick the giant golden ball off the trophy. Luckily, Supertato and the Tato Team are there to save the day, and they still win the match!

Maddie follows the journey the wood takes: from cutting the planks, to building the frame, to making the upholstery to cover it. Maddie puts her special slow-motion camera inside a cushion to show us how a special machine blasts the feathers into the cushions at incredible speeds.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Tinks is a disability assistance dog for her owner Charli, who has a condition that makes it painful for her to pick things up or to push and pull things. Tinks uses her superfetch skills to help Charli every day. The smallest of the Dog Squad gang, Tinks is a little Lhasa Apso with lots of big dog energy. Charli has been invited to a party but is feeling a bit nervous about going. Tinks loves helping Charli feel confident. She wants to help Charli feel good about herself so she can go and have fun at the party. Tinks fetches Charli’s hairbrush so Charli can brush her newly dyed pink hair, and then helps Charli choose a party outfit. And, when Charli can’t find her keys, Tinks dives into a mountain of clothes on the bed to search for them. Now they’re party ready, but it's raining! Tinks is determined to help Charli get to the party, even in the rain. But how? She summons all her big dog energy and sets off in search of a plan. Just wait until Dog Squad hear about this!

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet some elands, the largest type of antelope, which spend most of their days grazing on grass. The pair discover that these huge animals can leap high into the air. Next, Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet some colobus monkeys, which jump and leap all around them. They have an incredible close encounter with these marvellous monkeys. These two animals are very different, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between them.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Oona and Baba search for soft bedding for their burrow.

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: Animated series about a group of singing potatoes. Ruby and her friends head off to the barbershop to get their hair styled in this Motown music video.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: The garden gang are intrigued when Yukee says she’s going to stay up late with them so that she can show them the Man in the Moon. But will they all be able to stay awake long enough to see him?

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs are camping in the woods with Dad. But when rain comes to spoil their campfire fun, they all rush inside the tent. Dad is not happy, but a visit from a cheerful little raindrop soon has the whole gang dancing around the tent.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Are you sitting comfortably? Then we'll begin a bedtime story all about the first five Numberblocks. Learn all about the numbers one, two, three, four and five with Numberblocks One to Five.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: O is fascinated as G grows her green hair into a grassy garden. P and friends pop in to make a popping pea pod in a pot, but when a digging dog shows up, it is time for trouble. This episode introduces the letters G and O and the words pot, pod, dog and dig.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin meets Jamie at the playing field to try out some different games, and George joins them for a game of boccia. Mr Tumble is feeling sporty too as he gets ready to go swimming. The spotty surprise is a sports day race. Featuring signs for the words running track, swimming and medal.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Preschool series. Laa-Laa and Po play a game of hide-and-seek. They both take turns at hiding. Tinky Winky and Dipsy are hiding too and Laa-Laa and Po find them together.

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back 220 million years to the time of Coelophysis - one of the earliest dinosaurs that hunted in packs and was an expert at fishing. His mission is to find a fish to replace the one that was eaten by Taffy the cat back at the museum. Along the way he witnesses pterosaurs fishing, as well as discovering that the fish he's after buries itself in the ground when the river dries up. But will Andy succeed in time before the museum opens?

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s Stall. She chooses the plastic hook-a-duck and remembers the day she got it. Mack has organised a game day with lots of old-fashioned games at the Big Hub and is desperate for it to be a success. At first, everyone joins in the fun and things go well. Alice sets up Snakes and Ladders in the Cafe, and Magnus is very keen to play his family’s favourite game, Chinbeard. Unfortunately, as the day goes on, things start to go awry. Mrs Juniper and Moira become a little too competitive over Snakes and Ladders, and Magnus can’t find anyone who knows how to play his favourite game. Can any of the Hubbers help Mack before game day turns into a complete disaster?

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: CBeebies’ very own motorcycle rider, Grace, shows off three amazing machines that all go on water. Grace first lifts off the water using a hydrofoil surfboard, then she shows off an amazing yacht transporter and does her best superhero impression on a hydroflier!

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Tiny and Small plant a little plant in mother's garden, but they get impatient for it to grow. They sing a growing song as the cloud fills their watering can but do not anticipate the effect this mixture of water and music will have on their plant! Only the intervention of the plant-eating Sky Moos saves their planet from being overrun by vegetation!

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa think they’ve found a butterfly but are surprised to learn that it’s a moth - it sleeps during the day and comes out to play at night. At Play Time, they shine a toy torch into dark places and accidentally disturb the moth. It follows them to Yummy Land, where the Yummies help the friends learn more about nocturnal life, gifting them a moon flower that only opens at night.

programme.title: American Dad!
programme.desc: Animated series about CIA agent Stan Smith. When Stan goes to Atlantic City for a bachelor party and is shunned by his so-called best friend, Roger steps in and becomes Stan's new sidekick. Their friendship goes to a whole new level, but when they return home and face Francine, Stan realises that what happens in Atlantic City does not necessarily stay there. Meanwhile, Hayley and Steve team up to break up a good-looking couple.

programme.title: Bob's Burgers
programme.desc: Animated comedy about Bob Belcher, who runs Bob's Burgers restaurant, and his family. When the Belchers decide to spend a Thanksgiving morning playing mini golf, the empty course becomes a battlefield of emotions for the family with Linda vainly chasing the thrill of a fluke hole-in-one, Gene and Louise trying to 'hack' a mechanical yeti hole sculpture, and Tina agonising over how to ask her parents about an event that she wishes to attend.

programme.title: Bob's Burgers
programme.desc: Animated comedy about Bob Belcher, who runs Bob's Burgers restaurant, and his family. Teddy is deeply uncertain about his love life and destiny in general and hopes that the return of Kirby's Comet to the skies will give him a sign from the universe - when he and the Belchers then go to an official comet-watching event, Tina goes on an apology spree, Linda searches for kettle corn, and Bob finds himself in the unlikely role of spiritual counsellor to his friend. Meanwhile, Gene and Louise stockpile huge amounts of combustible wish paper.

programme.desc: Home improvement programme where contractor Brian McCourt and designer Sarah Keenleyside help to expand living spaces by tapping into people's backyards. programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern hosts the exciting and iconic gameshow as one of his brave contestants dares to face the infamous Banker and, by opening those iconic 22 red boxes in the right order, could be in with the chance of winning a life-changing cash prize. There are no questions here except for one: Deal or No Deal?

programme.title: Dress To Impress
programme.desc: 21-year-old skater boy Seb from Birmingham is looking for love - he's got three single girls shopping in Manchester for him. The twist is that he doesn't get to see the girls and has to judge them entirely based on the outfits they pick him - whoever best hits his brief will win a date! Dancer Grace, barber Ella, and make-up student Hope are battling it out for Seb's affections, but who will Dress to Impress?

programme.title: Billie & Greg: The Family Diaries
programme.desc: Reality series. It's a busy week for the Shepherds as Arthur's seventh birthday is approaching and Billie and Greg must decide whether to buy him a games console or not - however, all plans are put on hold as Margot suffers a febrile seizure and is rushed to hospital. The incident terrifies Billie and Greg who book a first aid course in case it happens again, but when Margot still doesn't recover afterwards, a concerned Billie takes her back to hospital.

programme.title: The Only Way is Essex
programme.desc: Pete and Chloe Sims drop a major bombshell in a therapy session when they admit that the lines have been blurred when it comes to their friendship - the advice they received was straightforward, take some time apart or lose the friendship, and both parties are determined to stick to it... but how will each of them cope without the other when push comes to shove, does absence really make the heart grow fonder, or is it a case of out of sight, out of mind for good? Elsewhere, Yaz and Amber have had their fair share of arguments - but they are BFFs right now as far as they're concerned and nothing's going to get in the way of that... step forward Nicole, Yaz's oldest friend who has some very strong opinions on Miss Turner and isn't afraid to share them with Yaz. Nicole thinks Amber is a fake friend who makes Yaz feel insecure - when Amber crashes their girls' spa trip, will Nicole be able to hold her tongue or will she deliver some home truths to her bestie's bestie?

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City
programme.desc: US reality series peeking inside the unconventional lives of six successful women living in or around Salt Lake City, Utah. programme.desc: 1942. Director: Jean Yarbrough. Stars Arline Judge, John King & Mantan Moreland. Nona Brooks earns a temporary living singing in a cafe in Duakwa, British Rhodesia, Africa. [S]

programme.title: Star Performance
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Director: Roy Kellino. Stars Macdonald Carey, Frances Rafferty & Dick Wessel. A clown achieves the fame he desired but at a cost. Can he overcome the loneliness that overshadows him? [S]

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Cynical Traitor. 1964. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Charles Morgan. Marriott is undercover to find who is selling plans about a field gun, stolen from the War Office. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: The Magic Book. 1956. Stars William Russell, Ronald Leigh-Hunt & Cyril Smith. Sir Lancelot helps to keep safe an Abbey and the occupants from invaders. [S]

programme.title: Broken Journey
programme.desc: 1948. Drama. Directors: Ken Annakin & Michael C Chorlton. Stars Phyllis Calvert, James Donald & David Tomlinson. A plane crash lands miles from civilisation. The passengers must prevail. [S]

programme.title: The Happiest Days of Your Life
programme.desc: 1950. Comedy. Directed by Frank Launder. Stars Alastair Sim, Margaret Rutherford & John Turnbull. Chaos ensues for staff and students when an all-boys and an all-girls school are merged into one. [S]

programme.title: A Pocketful of Rye 1955
programme.desc: 1955. A documentary short exploring the ancient town of Rye in Sussex, the surrounding Romney Marshes, and Bodiam Castle. [S]

programme.title: Railway Murders
programme.desc: The Guardsman. 2021. Stars Nicholas Day, Judith Rowbotham & Alan Moss. 28 year old Geoffrey Charles Dean was murdered by a railway fireman who stole £160 from the railway booking office. [S]

programme.title: Strange But True?
programme.desc: Venetian Palace Incident. 1996. Michael Aspel explores the story of a group of people who experienced a disturbance that cut their holiday in a Venetian Palace short. Featuring Joan Collins. [S]

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: The Newly Weds. 1974. Stars Julia Goodman, Patrick O'Connell & Jennifer Wilson. Barbara tries to placate her mother after revealing her news. Bill admits to Jennifer that all is not well at home. [S]

programme.title: Mark Saber
programme.desc: Jockey Missing. 1959. Stars Donald Gray, Robert Arden & Carl Duering. A young jockey disappears after his victory. The stable owner's daughter asks Mark Saber to investigate. [S]

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters...
programme.desc: ...Social Club. Episode 3. 1974. Stephane Grappelli plays Walking my Baby Back Home. Little and Large, Tony Brutus, The Barcias, Terri Rogers and Lonnie Donegan also perform. [S]

programme.title: Frankenstein and the Monster...
programme.desc: ...from Hell. 1974. Horror. Director Terence Fisher. Stars Peter Cushing, Shane Briant & Madeline Smith. Frankenstein continues his experiments at a mental asylum and he reanimates a new creation. [S]

programme.title: The Last Man on Earth
programme.desc: 1964. Horror. Directed by Ubaldo Ragona & Sidney Salkow. Stars Vincent Price & Franca Bettoia. When a disease turns all humans into vampiric zombies, the last man on earth must fight to survive.
